rows.v: Tech (QQQ) in a downtrend, fear elevated.
QQQ has lagged SPY by 4.9 points over 20 sessions. Tech is the weak spot; the broad market is holding up better.
In the previous note (Nov 20), both indexes had just set new 1-month lows. On Nov 23 they bounced sharply: SPY rose 4.71% to 722.29 and QQQ rose 7.0% to 651.03.

A QQQ close above 682.29 together with a VIX reading below 30 would clear the market gate and support moving from 'stand aside' to 'selective'. A QQQ close below 608.45 or an SPY close below 689.81 would set new 1-month lows.
